6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses I. Warranty: 05 Years warranty from the date of successful installation and commissioning of the equipm ent / instrument. If the whole equipment / instrument is found defective during the warranty period the sa me will have to be replaced / repaired at CSIR-IMMT, Bhubaneswar, free of cost. All the cost involved will b e borne by the supplier. II. Payment Terms: 100% percent payment within 30 days after successful installation, commissioning a nd training of the equipment / instrument and after submission of all documents. III.GST TDS/TCS/Income tax and other Taxes, if applicable will be deducted as per applicable st atutory norms prescribed by the Govt. IV. PERFORMANCE BANK GUARANTEE: An unconditional Performance Bank Guarantee for 05% of the t otal contract value needs to be submitted within 21days of issue of the Purchase Order to be valid till 60 d ays beyond the completion of the warranty period of 05 years i.e. for 62 months from the date of successf ul installation and commissioning of the equipment / instruments. In addition to it, the PBG shall be extend ed towards any short fall due to delay in delivery and installation. V. Denial Clause: No upward price variation including statutory levies will be admissible beyond the origi nal scheduled delivery date for default on the part of the supplier. However, downward price variation wou ld be availed by the purchase as per the denial clause in the letter of extension of the delivery period. VI. Amendment: Any amendment made will be treated as the part of the contract. VII. Replacement: All incidental expenses concerned to warranty / faulty items replacement will be born e by the supplier. VIII. Settlement of Disputes: The purchaser and the supplier shall make every effort to resolve amicabl y by direct informal negotiation any disagreement or dispute arising between them under or in connection with the Contract. All disputes, differences and questions which may, if any time, arise shall be referred to Delhi International Arbitration Centre (DIAC), Delhi High Court, New Delhi as per the provisions of Indian Ar bitration and Reconciliation Act 1996 and his award shall be final and binding on the parties to the dispute. IX. Jurisdiction: Place of Jurisdiction is Bhubaneswar. X. The bidder has to sign a contract, on a non-judicial stamp paper of Rs. 100/- as per the format provided in ANNEXURE -XV of the ATC / Tender document on the total value of the contract within 15 days of the aw ard of Contract. XI. The firm is also to sign integrity pact on a non-judicial stamp paper of Rs. 100/- as per the format provi ded in ANNEXURE -IV of the ATC / Tender document of CSIR-IMMT. XII. DIRECTOR, CSIR-IMMT RESERVES ALL RIGHTS TO CANCEL THIS CONTRACT AT ANY STAGE. .
